summary: L-5 cab on a 10-foot log base, built 1932 in Gifford Pinchot NF; removal date unknown, and little remains on a cliff-edged ridge.

facts.design: L-5 cab on a 10-foot log base
facts.status_note: The cab is gone. The register does not say when it was removed.

visit.trail_note: From paved FR 25, take forest road FR 2573 about 1.7 miles to a bend with parking, then walk the abandoned Wildcat Trail. Willhite lists the distance as 0.4 miles.

events.note: L-5 cab on a 10-foot log base, per the register, firelookout.com and Willhite. None of them names the builder or why this spot was chosen.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 3,105 ft (946 m), which matches the record's 946.4 m. Willhite's page gives a rounder 3,000 feet. The record keeps the register figure.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: four web pages and the FFLA list. No source read names the builder, gives the reason for the site, dates staffing, dates the removal, or states a current access rule, so access is left out of facts and the story says none was found. The record's access stays unknown. Willhite's captions (1932 cab, 1936 views, 2018 site photo) and the Weebly page do not state a licence, so no new photos are added. The Weebly page has a bare 'Removed' line near the entry; its meaning is unclear, so it is not used. Worth checking with the Gifford Pinchot National Forest for current access or any closure.
